About this Privacy Policy
This Privacy Policy applies to DramaFlix, a short-form drama streaming mini program operated by MORDERN MAGIC GROUP LIMITED on the TikTok platform. DramaFlix is a product brand of MORDERN MAGIC GROUP LIMITED. References in this policy to "MORDERN MAGIC", "we", "us", or "our" refer to MORDERN MAGIC GROUP LIMITED, the data controller responsible for the DramaFlix mini app.

MORDERN MAGIC GROUP LIMITED — Privacy Policy

Effective Date: July 20, 2026
Last Updated: July 20, 2026

1. Introduction & Data Controller

MORDERN MAGIC GROUP LIMITED (MORDERN MAGIC, we, us, or our) is a company incorporated in Wyoming, United States, with its registered office at [Registered Address]. For the purposes of applicable data protection law, MORDERN MAGIC GROUP LIMITED is the data controller of your personal information collected through the Service.

We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, with whom we share it, and what rights you have in relation to your information. By using the Service, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

If you have any questions or wish to exercise your rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@mordernmagic.com.

2. Information We Collect

We collect the following categories of information:

2.1 Account Information

  • Username, display name, email address
  • Password (stored as a one-way hash, not in plaintext)
  • Profile photo (optional, user-provided)
  • Date of birth (for age verification)
  • Country/region (for content availability and tax calculation)

2.3 Third-Party Login Information

If you sign in via a third-party identity provider, we receive:

  • TikTok: open_id, union_id, nickname, avatar
  • Google: Google account ID, email, profile photo
  • Apple: Apple User ID, email (may be a private relay)
  • Facebook: Facebook User ID, name, email

2.3 Order and Payment Information

  • Transaction history (subscription, virtual currency, pay-per-episode)
  • Payment method type (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, PayPal — not the full card number)
  • Billing receipts and invoices
  • All actual payment processing is performed by TikTok Pay. We do not collect or store your full payment card number.

2.4 Device and Technical Information

  • IP address
  • Device type, manufacturer, model
  • Operating system and version
  • Unique device identifiers (IDFA, GAID, OAID)
  • Browser type and version (for web access)
  • Mobile carrier information
  • Time zone setting and language preference
  • App version

2.5 Usage and Behavioral Information

  • Content viewing history (titles, episodes watched, completion rate)
  • Search queries within the Service
  • Liked, favorited, and bookmarked content
  • Comments and reviews submitted
  • Time spent on the Service

2.6 Cookies and Tracking Technologies (Web)

  • Essential cookies (session, authentication, security)
  • Analytics cookies (page views, performance)
  • Marketing cookies (with your consent)
  • We use cookies and similar tracking technologies in accordance with applicable law, including the EU ePrivacy Directive.

2.7 Push Notification Token

  • Device push token (for sending notifications you have opted in to)
  • Notification interaction history (delivery, open, dismiss)

2.8 User-Generated Content

  • Reviews, comments, ratings
  • Customer support inquiries
  • Survey responses

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information for the following purposes:

  1. To provide and operate the Service, including processing transactions and delivering content.
  2. To manage your account, including authentication, authorization, and customer support.
  3. To personalize your experience, including content recommendations based on viewing history and preferences.
  4. To communicate with you, including transactional notifications, service updates, security alerts, and (with your consent) marketing communications.
  5. To detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, security issues, and violations of our Terms.
  6. To comply with legal obligations, including tax, accounting, anti-money laundering, and law enforcement requests.
  7. To enforce our Terms and protect our rights, property, and safety, and that of our users and third parties.
  8. To improve the Service, including analytics, research, and product development.
  9. To process payments and prevent fraudulent transactions, in coordination with TikTok Pay and payment processors.

We do not use your content viewing history for purposes that are incompatible with those listed above.

4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

If you are in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, we process your personal information on the following legal bases under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):

  • Contract (Article 6(1)(b)): To provide the Service you have requested, including subscription management and content delivery.
  • Legitimate Interests (Article 6(1)(f)): To operate, secure, and improve the Service, prevent fraud, and enforce our Terms, where our interests are not overridden by your fundamental rights.
  • Consent (Article 6(1)(a)): For non-essential cookies, marketing communications, and certain analytics. You may withdraw your consent at any time.
  • Legal Obligation (Article 6(1)(c)): To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal processes.
  • Vital Interests (Article 6(1)(d)): To protect your vital interests or those of another person in exceptional circumstances.

5. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We share your information only as follows:

5.1 Service Providers

We share information with third-party service providers that perform services on our behalf, including:

  • Cloud hosting and storage (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Aliyun)
  • Content delivery network (CDN) providers
  • Customer support platforms
  • Email and notification delivery (e.g., OneSignal, PushEngage, SendGrid)
  • Analytics providers (e.g., Google Analytics, Firebase, AppsFlyer, Adjust)
  • Payment processors (primarily TikTok Pay)
  • Customer data platform (e.g., Segment, mParticle)
  • Marketing and advertising partners (only with your consent where required)

5.2 Advertising and Attribution Partners

With your consent (where required), we share information with:

  • TikTok Pixel and TikTok Events API (for ad attribution and optimization)
  • Facebook Pixel and Conversions API
  • Google Ads and Google Marketing Platform
  • Apple Search Ads
  • AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch (mobile attribution)

5.3 TikTok and Other Platforms

  • As a TikTok mini program, we receive certain information from TikTok and share certain information with TikTok, subject to TikTok's Privacy Policy and our data sharing arrangements.
  • If you sign in via TikTok, Google, Apple, or Facebook, those platforms receive notice of your sign-in.

5.4 Legal Requirements

We may disclose your information:

  • To comply with applicable law, regulation, court order, or legal process.
  • To respond to lawful requests from public authorities, including law enforcement.
  • To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users or third parties.
  • To detect, prevent, or address fraud, security, or technical issues.
  • In connection with a corporate transaction (merger, acquisition, financing, restructuring, or sale of assets), with appropriate confidentiality protections.

5.5 Aggregate or De-identified Information

We may share aggregate or de-identified information with third parties for research, analytics, marketing, or other purposes, provided that such information cannot reasonably be used to identify you.

6. International Data Transfers

Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence, including the United States, China, Singapore, and other countries where our service providers operate.

For transfers from the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland to countries not deemed adequate by the European Commission, we rely on appropriate safeguards, including:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission
  • The UK International Data Transfer Addendum (where applicable)
  • Binding Corporate Rules (where applicable)
  • Your explicit consent (where applicable)

For transfers from other jurisdictions, we comply with applicable local data localization requirements.

You may contact privacy@mordernmagic.com to request a copy of the transfer safeguards applicable to your data.

7. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide the Service and fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

Specific retention periods include:

  • Account information: For the duration of your account, plus 30 days after deletion to allow for recovery.
  • Transaction records: 7 years (for tax and accounting purposes).
  • Viewing history: 24 months.
  • Marketing consent records: Until you withdraw consent, plus 3 years.
  • Support correspondence: 3 years.
  • Server logs: 90 days.
  • Backup data: Up to 12 months in encrypted form.

When personal information is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.

8. Your Rights by Region

Depending on your jurisdiction, you have the following rights:

8.1 European Economic Area, United Kingdom, and Switzerland (GDPR/UK GDPR)

  • Right of access: Request a copy of your personal information.
  • Right to rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Right to erasure (right to be forgotten): Request deletion of your data in certain circumstances.
  • Right to restrict processing: Limit how we use your data in certain circumstances.
  • Right to data portability: Receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
  • Right to object: Object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing.
  • Right to withdraw consent: Where processing is based on consent, withdraw it at any time.
  • Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority: Contact your local data protection authority.
  • Right to effective judicial remedy.

We will respond to your request within 30 days. In complex cases, we may extend this period by up to 60 days and will notify you of the extension.

8.2 California, USA (CCPA/CPRA)

  • Right to know: Request disclosure of the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected.
  • Right to delete: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.
  • Right to correct: Request correction of inaccurate personal information.
  • Right to opt-out of sale or sharing: We do not sell your information. You may opt out of cross-context behavioral advertising.
  • Right to limit use of sensitive personal information: We do not use sensitive personal information beyond what is necessary to provide the Service.
  • Right to non-discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

We will respond to verifiable consumer requests within 45 days.

California Shine the Light (California Civil Code Section 1798.83): California residents may request information about categories of personal information disclosed to third parties for those third parties direct marketing purposes. We do not disclose your information to third parties for their direct marketing purposes.

8.3 Virginia, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Montana (Other US State Privacy Laws)

Similar rights as California, with applicable variations. We honor all such rights for residents of applicable US states.

8.4 Japan (APPI)

  • Right to access
  • Right to correct
  • Right to cease use or delete
  • Right to opt out of usage for purposes other than original purpose
  • Right to data portability (where applicable)

8.5 South Korea (PIPA)

  • Right to access
  • Right to correct
  • Right to delete
  • Right to cease processing
  • Right to opt out of automated decision-making
  • Right to data portability

8.6 Brazil (LGPD)

  • Right to confirmation and access
  • Right to correction
  • Right to anonymization, blocking, or deletion
  • Right to data portability
  • Right to deletion of consent
  • Right to information about sharing

8.7 Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore)

We comply with applicable local data protection laws in these jurisdictions, including:

  • Vietnam: Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection
  • Thailand: Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019)
  • Singapore: Personal Data Protection Act 2012
  • Philippines: Data Privacy Act of 2012
  • Indonesia: Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection
  • Malaysia: Personal Data Protection Act 2010

8.8 How to Exercise Your Rights

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at privacy@mordernmagic.com. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request. We will not charge you for making a request, unless the request is manifestly unfounded or excessive.

9. Children Privacy

  • The Service is not directed to children under 13 (in the US under COPPA) or under 16 (in the EU under GDPR).
  • We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below the applicable age threshold.
  • If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child below the applicable age threshold without verifiable parental consent, we will delete it as soon as possible.
  • Parents and guardians who believe we have collected information about their child may contact us at privacy@mordernmagic.com to request deletion.

10. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies on our web properties. Categories include:

  • Strictly Necessary: Required for the Service to function (authentication, security, session management). Cannot be disabled.
  • Performance and Analytics: Help us understand how users interact with the Service (page views, error tracking). You may opt out.
  • Functionality: Remember your preferences (language, region). You may opt out.
  • Marketing and Advertising: Used to deliver relevant ads and measure ad performance. Requires your consent in applicable jurisdictions.

For users in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, and Switzerland, we obtain your consent before setting non-essential cookies, in accordance with the ePrivacy Directive. You may withdraw your consent at any time via our cookie management tool.

For Do Not Track (DNT) browser signals, we honor DNT where technically feasible.

11. Security Measures

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information, including:

  • Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256)
  • Access controls and authentication (role-based, multi-factor for staff)
  • Regular security audits and penetration testing
  • Incident response and breach notification procedures
  • Vendor security assessments
  • Employee training on data protection

While we strive to protect your information, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

In the event of a personal data breach affecting you, we will notify you and applicable regulators in accordance with applicable law.

12. Changes to This Policy

  • We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
  • For material changes, we will provide at least 30 days prior notice through the Service or by email.
  • The Last Updated date at the top of this Policy will reflect the date of the most recent change.
  • Your continued use of the Service after the effective date of the revised Policy constitutes your acceptance of the changes.
  • If you do not agree to the changes, you may close your account.

Previous versions of this Policy are available upon request to privacy@mordernmagic.com.

14. Specific Provisions for California / EU / UK

14.1 California Specific (Shine the Light)

California Civil Code Section 1798.83 permits California residents to request information about the categories of personal information disclosed to third parties for those third parties direct marketing purposes. We do not share your information with third parties for their direct marketing purposes.

14.2 EU/UK Specific

  • The European Commissions Online Dispute Resolution platform is available at https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.
  • For complaints that we cannot resolve directly, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
  • A list of EU data protection authorities is available at https://edpb.europa.eu/about-edpb/about-edpb/members_en.
  • The UK Information Commissioners Office is available at https://ico.org.uk.

14.3 Authorized Representative (Article 27 GDPR)

If you are in the European Economic Area and we are required to appoint an authorized representative under Article 27 GDPR, details will be provided here upon appointment.

End of Privacy Policy
